title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Genesis 1: the six days of creation, from the first light to mankind made in God's image.

questions.text: According to the first verse, what did God create in the beginning?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:1 says that in the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

questions.text: What was hovering over the surface of the waters?
questions.explanation: The earth was formless and empty, darkness was on the surface of the deep, and God's Spirit was hovering over the waters.

questions.text: What did God call the light?
questions.explanation: God called the light "day", and the darkness he called "night".

questions.text: What did God call the expanse He made in the middle of the waters?
questions.explanation: God made the expanse to divide the waters, and called the expanse "sky". There was evening and morning, a second day.

questions.text: On which day did the earth yield grass, herbs and fruit trees?
questions.explanation: God told the earth to yield grass, herbs and fruit trees, and it did. Then there was evening and morning, a third day.

questions.text: What were the lights in the sky to be signs for?
questions.explanation: God made lights in the sky to divide the day from the night, and to be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years.

answers.text: To mark seasons, days, and years

questions.text: Which creatures did God make on the fifth day?
questions.explanation: God filled the waters with living creatures and made every winged bird. There was evening and morning, a fifth day.

answers.text: Animals of the earth and man

questions.text: In whose image did God create man?
questions.explanation: God created man in his own image; in God's image he created him, male and female.

questions.text: What did God give people for food in Genesis 1?
questions.explanation: God gave them every herb yielding seed and every tree that bears fruit yielding seed as food.

answers.text: Fish of the sea and birds of the sky

questions.text: What did God see when He looked at everything He had made?
questions.explanation: God saw everything that he had made, and it was very good. That was the sixth day.
